name: Kajabi
mood: gallery white walls holding warm portraits
summary: Achromatic editorial UI with white canvas, near-black text and CTAs, Haffer typography, 2px rectangular corners, flat surfaces, dark video bands, and human photography as the only chromatic expression.
useWhen: Course and knowledge commerce landing pages
Editorial SaaS pages for expert-led products
Interfaces where human photography should carry emotional color
avoidWhen: Playful SaaS pages needing bright brand color
Dense dashboards with many nested controls
Brands relying on illustration or gradients
Interfaces that cannot use high-quality photography or video

paperWhite.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, inverse text on dark backgrounds

inkBlack.role: Primary text, filled CTA buttons, navigation, footer

charcoal.role: Dark section backgrounds, video frame borders, elevated dark surfaces

smoke.role: Input text, focused form borders, higher-emphasis neutral copy

stone.role: Secondary body text, muted helper text, subdued list and border accents

driftwood.role: Tertiary text, icon strokes, subtle borders

sand.role: Link borders at rest, muted borders, decorative dividers

graphite.role: Stronger form borders, table separators, visible dividers

ash.role: Hairline borders, card outlines, dividers between content blocks

mist.role: Light surface tint, input backgrounds, secondary card surfaces

imagery.direction: Full-bleed expert portraits, creator photography, warm lifestyle video, coaching and workspace scenes, natural skin tones, no filters.
imagery.avoid: Illustrations, 3D renders, abstract gradients, duotone overlays, chromatic UI decoration.
